svg.data-weight-note: 22 kg (48.50 lb) fully loaded without optics (guide Table 7, datasheet Table 2)
svg.data-throughput: 51.2 Tbps unidirectional and 102.4 Tbps bidirectional (datasheet Table 2)
svg.data-breakout-ports: 64 x 800 GbE, 128 x 400 GbE, 256 x 200 GbE or 256 x 100 GbE; up to 320 ports at mixed speeds (datasheet Table 2)
svg.data-osfp-speeds: 800 GbE; 400 GbE and lower with breakout (datasheet Table 2)
svg.data-power-measurement-note: Maximum at 40 C ambient with SR optics (datasheet: DR optics) at 100 percent load with IMIX traffic; typical at 25 C with DACs at 50 percent load with IMIX traffic, excluding transceivers (guide Table 13, datasheet)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 200 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz, 16 A maximum (guide Table 4); 200 to 277 VAC (guide Table 13); 180 to 264 VAC (datasheet)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 1+1, hot-removable and hot-insertable (guide, Component Redundancy)
svg.data-fans: four fan modules of two rotors, N+1 at rotor level; front-to-back only
svg.data-airflow-note: AO is front-to-back (port-to-FRU, airflow out); the guide describes no back-to-front module
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1828.8 m (6000 ft) at 0 to 40 C with DAC cables; sea level with optics (guide Table 17)
svg.data-optics-osfp: 800 GbE OSFP; ports 1, 2, 5, 6, 9, 10 and so on in the two middle rows take high power optics such as 800G-ZR and ZR+ (guide, Port Panel note)
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15; ICES-003; BS EN 55032; BS EN 55035; EN 300 386; CISPR 32; CISPR 35; IEC/EN 61000 series; VCCI-CISPR 32; BSMI CNS 15936 (datasheet)
svg.data-nebs: designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements of NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3 (guide Table 17)
svg.data-substances: RoHS; TSCA; POPs; WEEE; REACH; SCIP (datasheet)
